name: Gangan Namauchi 2
source:
The main character Toshio is an ordinary student who likes games. On the first day of summer vacation, two beautiful girls from the future appear in front of Toshio's eyes. The names of the two are Tomoyo and Yuki.

"We have received your sperm from the future three hundred years later."

Toshio who is surprised and surprised by too loud talk.
On Earth after 300 years, human genes were completely analyzed. And genes that make excellent brains, genes with high physical ability, genes of longevity, genes of beautiful forms ... all the parents replaced the genes of the child they were born to make excellent children.
However, artificial gene manipulation that spans generations has caused serious problems. Children born from parents with similar genes had a high probability of having birth defects, and the birth rate itself dropped sharply. Finally, the men are gone, and the few remaining frozen stored spermatozoa are also low. Therefore, a project to collect as many sperm as possible was started back to the time before genetic manipulation was performed.
translation:
主人公俊夫是个喜欢游戏的普通学生。暑假的第一天，两名来自未来的美少女出现在他面前。她们的名字是智美与由纪。

“我们从三百年后的未来收集到了你的精子。”

面对这番过于大胆的话，俊夫惊讶得说不出话来。
三百年后的地球，人类基因已经得到彻底解析。优秀头脑、高超体能、长寿体质、美丽外貌……为了培育出优秀的孩子，所有父母都会替新生儿更换基因。
然而，跨越世代的人工基因改造引发了严重问题。拥有相似基因的父母所生的孩子，先天缺陷概率极高，出生率本身也急剧下降。最终，男性彻底消失，所剩无几的冷冻储存精子也濒临枯竭。因此，人们启动了一项计划，回到基因改造开始之前的时代，尽可能收集更多精子。
